name: State Farm
why: Largest U.S. auto and home insurer; agent-based nationwide with a consolidated State Farm Payment Plan billing account.

name: GEICO
why: Second-largest U.S. auto insurer (Berkshire Hathaway); direct writer nationwide.

name: Progressive
why: Top-three U.S. auto insurer; direct and agent channels nationwide.

name: Allstate
why: Top-five U.S. personal auto/home insurer with a national agent network.

name: USAA (auto & property insurance)
why: Major national auto/home insurer for military members and families; distinct from USAA bank/card records.

name: Liberty Mutual (personal insurance)
why: Top-ten U.S. personal lines insurer; also services Safeco policies.

name: Farmers Insurance
why: Top-ten U.S. auto/home insurer with a large agent network.

name: Nationwide (personal auto, home & life)
why: Large national mutual insurer for auto, home and life; pet insurance is a separate record.

name: Travelers (personal insurance)
why: Major national personal-lines insurer sold through independent agents.

name: American Family Insurance (AmFam)
why: Large Midwest/West mutual auto/home insurer; top-ten personal auto writer.
